rationales: A nested list places one list inside another, not simply items with descriptions.
An ordered list numbers its items rather than pairing terms with descriptions.
An unordered list displays items without numbering or term-description pairs.
A definition list is used to present items alongside their descriptions.
A tag is markup used to structure or format webpage content, not the clickable destination element itself.
A list groups items and is not the clickable element described.
A hyperlink is an icon, graphic, or text that can take a user to another webpage.
A link is also a common term for a clickable hyperlink, so the question has two valid options.
The terminal symbol represents the start or end of a flowchart.
A connector joins separated parts of a flowchart.
A process symbol represents an operation or action.
A diamond represents a decision or condition.
1024⁴ bytes is a terabyte, not a petabyte.
1024⁶ bytes is larger than a petabyte under the binary convention used here.
A petabyte is 1024⁵ bytes under the binary convention used in this context.
1024⁷ bytes is larger than a petabyte under the binary convention used here.
AND combines two or more propositions.
NOT is a unary logical operator that acts on one proposition.
OR combines two or more propositions.
Addition is an arithmetic operation, not a logical operator that uses one proposition.
Routers connect multiple networks and direct traffic between them.
Channels carry signals but are not what routers connect together in this definition.
Addresses identify network devices or destinations; routers do not connect addresses together.
Protocols are rules for communication, not the entities routers connect together.
A password is used for authentication, but the term for a confidential software text or code is a key.
Encryption is a method of protecting information, not the confidential text itself.
A software key is the confidential text or code associated with the software.
Phishing is a fraudulent attempt to obtain sensitive information.
A nested list places one list inside another, rather than presenting peer options.
An ordered list is for items whose sequence or ranking matters.
A definition list pairs terms with their descriptions.
An unordered list presents multiple options without implying a particular order.
An anchor link can take a user to another location within the same page.
A tag is markup used to structure or format webpage content.
A hyperlink is a general clickable link and does not specifically mean an in-page link.
A link is a general clickable connection and does not specifically mean an in-page link.
Guess, check, and improve involves trying a solution and refining it, not breaking a task into subtasks.
Divide and conquer breaks a larger task into smaller tasks that can be organized in a to-do list.
Act it out involves simulating a process or situation.
Prototyping creates a preliminary model to test an idea.
Input/output is generally represented by a parallelogram.
A diamond represents a decision or condition in a flowchart.
Processing is generally represented by a rectangle.
A connector is generally represented by a small circle.
Decimal is base 10 and is not the fundamental number system used to store digital data.
Octal is base 8 and is not the fundamental number system used to store digital data.
Binary uses 0 and 1, the two states used by digital computers to store data.
Hexadecimal is a compact way to represent binary values, not the fundamental storage system.
(1000001)₂ equals 65 in decimal, not 66.
(1000001)₂ equals 65 in decimal, not 67.
(1000001)₂ equals 65 in decimal, not 69.
The intended <u> tag underlines text; the spaces shown are typographical spacing.
<ul> creates an unordered list, not underlined text.
<ui> is not the HTML tag used to underline text.
<uli> is not a valid HTML tag for underlining text.
A truth table lists outcomes of logical expressions; the quoted sentence is not a table.
A truth value is whether a proposition is true or false, not the sentence itself.
The sentence states an idea that can be judged true or false, so it is a proposition.
A compound proposition combines simpler propositions using logical connectives; this sentence does not.
